description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' that extends 'bsd_common' and provides system information methods specific to NetBSD, including network, disk, and system uptime details.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class providing system information for NetBSD systems, including network stats, disk info, and system uptime.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes regular expressions and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: get_sys_ticks
methods.description: Calculates system uptime in seconds based on kernel boot time.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics such as bytes, packets, errors, and drops.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Extracts IDE disk device information from system messages.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the filename of the NetBSD icon image.
